title: 第012章 仁义之君
content_zh:
“公子，您那手锯没用坏吧？”
“没有，很快就用完了，到时候我送过来。”
刘长有些听不懂他们的话，他们这些人说的话听起来有些尖锐，语调总是往上，刘长能听出几个词，不过顶多也就这样了。而刘恒却能正常的跟这些人交流，甚至能用他们的口音来聊天。
不知道的绝对听不出说这口音的居然是刘邦家的第四子。
不知为何，刘长心里忽然对刘恒生出了一股敬仰，这家伙真厉害。
刘恒跟他们亲切的聊着天，刘长几乎没有见过刘恒这个样子，平日里，刘恒总是沉默少言，板着脸，很是严肃，可是在这些人面前，刘恒却表现的很是亲切，那不是刻意做出的热情，就是一种跟好朋友聊天时的那种亲近感。
刘长拽了拽刘恒的衣袖，刘恒这才想起了身边这个小弟弟。
“这是我的七弟，公子长。”
刘恒将刘长介绍给了他们。
这些匠人的脸色大变，笑容瞬间消失，看向刘长的眼里满是惊惧，行为也开始变得拘束，有几个匠人直接跪在地上，朝着刘长行跪拜礼，刘长愣住了，这样与刘恒不同的尊重，并没有让他觉得开心。
他们看起来是那么的尊重自己，可刚才见过他们对刘恒的态度之后，刘长就觉得，这只是装出来的假尊重而已，真正的尊重，或许就是方才对刘恒时一样，有说有笑，将对方当作自己愿意亲近的朋友，而不是高高在上的主子。
人们很少会向朋友捅刀子，可太多主人都死在了自己的奴隶手中。
刘长如愿的拿到了自己所需要的工具，尺，刨，锉，虽然没有斧，但是也已经能开始动手制造了。
只是，从这里离开之后，刘长并没有那么的开心，情绪反而是有些沉重。
“兄长...阿父是一个仁义的天子吗？”
“是。”
“那他为什么要这样对待那些人？衣不蔽体..为什么不给他们配辆马车？”
“你知道修建长乐宫的匠人有多少吗？”
“不知道。”
“数万之众。”

“阿父没有饿着他们，给他们休息的时间，他们只需要在农忙之后幸苦数个月，这已经是很大的恩赐了。”
“这也算是恩赐？”
“当然算，你知道当初修长城的有多少人吗？”
“应该很多吧...”
“他们大多数要自备粮食，没有多少休息的时间...在秦二世时期，更是一年四季都在修建，农忙也无法回家，农田被荒废，当吃的用完，他们每天只能得到一点点的粮食，以次充好，他们戴着脚镣，住在野外，甲士随时会杀死干不动活的百姓...你现在想想，阿父算是仁义天子吗？”
“是。”
这一次，刘长终于不迟疑了，若是对比从前，刘邦的确算是少有的仁义天子，为自己修建皇宫，也只是发动了数万人的徭役，给吃给喝，还算准时间，宁愿误工也不耽误农忙，不会胡乱杀人。
“可是...我还是觉得他们过的很不好。”
“过的不好的，不只是他们。”
刘恒没有跟刘长再谈这方面的问题，很平静的跟他告了别，只是在离开之前，刘恒盯着他的眼睛，沉重的说道：“等你将来当了诸侯王，别忘了今天看到的这一幕。”
刘长愣在原地，看着刘恒渐行渐远。
他忽然觉得，或许这个哥哥比刘盈更适合当天子，只可惜，四哥不是嫡长子。
回到了椒房殿，有了一切工具的刘长，开始动手制造纺车，因为先前已经做好了设计图，因此动手做这些零件的时候，就要方便很多，他最先就是要将综框和机架给做出来。
他找到了自己藏起来的木料，这些木料大多都是方形的，甚至不需要刘长再进行其他加工，拿来就可以用，因为没有钉子，他只能用榫卯的方式来稳定机架。
榫卯这东西说起来容易，可若是不懂木工的人，做起来是真的难，刘长前世也没动手做过榫卯，前几次的组装都因为测量和木料问题而失败了，直接散架。因为没有先进的机器，所有的一切都要刘长亲自动手，光是做出榫卯就耗费了刘长很长的一段时间。
他做的比以前还要努力，大概是因为他见过了那些匠人们所穿的东西，那破布条历历在目。
就在刘长做出了机架，开始组装内部零件的时候，刘邦准备好了拜师礼。
在这个时代，拜师礼叫束脩，一般都是十条肉干，为了表示尊敬，刘邦还特意多准备了一些其他东西，在派人将刘长送过去的时候，刘邦还在嘱咐刘长：这是给你老师的！你个竖子千万不要偷吃啊！！
刘长很是不满，我是那种人嘛？
刘长终于出宫了，这是他第一次出宫，他也成为了除刘肥，刘盈，刘如意之外的第四位出宫的皇子。坐在马车上，刘长对一切都很好奇，只可惜，皇宫之外的情况，跟皇宫之内的没有什么区别。

到处都是一片萧瑟，看不到人影，灰白的建筑隔绝了一切，而韩信府邸与皇宫又太近，刘长甚至还没有看到什么人，就已经来到了韩信的府邸里，韩信早已得知了消息，派出下人来迎接这位皇子。
拜师礼并没有刘长所想的那么复杂。
就是简单的跪拜礼，献束脩，老师点头，这就完事了。
刘长对自己这位老师非常的好奇，在从前，他对韩信更多的是崇拜，可是在吕后的那番话之后，他心里又对韩信有些害怕，他对未来的确是一知半解，可即使这样，他也知道刘邦杀功臣的事情。
韩信似乎就是被刘邦给处死的。
刘长不知道韩信做了什么，但是他知道，阿父不是一个喜欢胡乱杀人的人。从其他人口中，刘长已经了解了不少关于韩信的事情，韩信在大汉的确很有名，他几个哥哥对他都是了如指掌。
但是，他们对韩信半是崇拜，半是不屑。
刘如意就曾当面告诉刘长，韩信不过就是一个失败的叛贼而已。
在刘如意的口中，刘长方才得知，韩信原来居然是楚王，这在史盲刘长心里很不可思议，楚王不是项羽嘛？？韩信这个楚王并没有做太久，他在当上楚王之后，开始操练军马，囤积粮食，广交好友...
刘邦顿时就坐不住了，韩信是有前科的。
当初刘邦跟项羽作战，被项羽打的四处乱跑，当时韩信正在齐地，接连获胜，于是刘邦向韩信求援，命令他快来救援，韩信就派出了使者。
韩信的使者告诉刘邦，让韩信来救援也可以，但是，您必须要封韩信为假王。
刘邦勃然大怒，当着韩信使者的面，破口大骂：“韩信这竖子，我被困在这里，他不救我，居然想要做什么假王？”
陈平听到这句话，即刻用脚尖狠狠踹了一下刘邦一下。
刘邦急忙改口骂道：“韩信这竖子也太没有志气了！大丈夫平定诸侯，那就要做个真王，何必做什么假王！！”
这件事让刘邦一直耿耿于怀，到后来，刘邦登基，封韩信为楚王，很快就察觉到了韩信有不轨的想法，刘邦因此向陈平请教，询问自己是否该出兵讨伐韩信。
刘长觉得，那时陈平肯定想骂：讨伐韩信？陛下心里有点比数嘛？？
不过，陈平还是没有骂出口，他只是淡定的询问：“您的军队比韩信的厉害嘛？”
“您的战将里谁能打得过韩信？”
然后刘邦就闭嘴了，开始询问有什么稳妥的办法。

陈平就给他出了云梦泽之计，让刘邦装作出游云梦泽，要在陈州会见各路诸侯。陈州在楚地西界，韩信听到天子出游，又到了他的地盘上，便前来谒见，当他谒见刘邦的时候，刘邦直接派人绑了他，将他抓了回去。
就这样，不费一兵一卒，刘邦就抓住了韩信，并且以谋反的罪名撤了他的楚王，改封为淮阴侯。
即使如此，刘邦也没有去杀了他，永结后患，说起来，刘邦真不是一个嗜杀的人，就韩信这些行为，其他任何一个君王，恐怕都是要杀死的。
因此，刘长觉得，韩信会被刘邦处死，肯定是在之后又做了什么大事，才导致刘邦痛下杀手。
content_en:
"Sir, your handsaw is not worn out, is it?"
"No, it will be used up soon. I will deliver it when the time comes."
Liu Chang couldn't understand their words. The words they spoke sounded a bit sharp and their tone was always upward. Liu Chang could make out a few words, but that was it at most. But Liu Heng was able to communicate with these people normally and even chat with their accents.
Those who didn't know would never know that the person speaking with this accent was actually the fourth son of Liu Bang's family.
For some reason, Liu Chang suddenly felt a sense of admiration for Liu Hengsheng. This guy is really awesome.
Liu Heng chatted cordially with them. Liu Chang had almost never seen Liu Heng like this. On weekdays, Liu Heng was always silent, with a straight face and very serious. However, in front of these people, Liu Heng behaved very cordially. It was not a deliberate enthusiasm, but a sense of intimacy like when chatting with a good friend.
Liu Chang tugged on Liu Heng's sleeve, and then Liu Heng remembered the little brother next to him.
"This is my seventh brother, the eldest son."
Liu Heng introduced Liu Chang to them.
The faces of these craftsmen changed drastically, and their smiles disappeared instantly. Their eyes when looking at Liu Chang were full of fear, and their behavior began to become restrained. Several craftsmen knelt directly on the ground and bowed to Liu Changxing. Liu Chang was stunned. Such a different respect from Liu Heng did not make him feel happy.
They seemed to respect him so much, but after seeing their attitude towards Liu Heng just now, Liu Chang felt that this was just fake respect. The real respect may be the same as he did to Liu Heng just now, talking and laughing, treating the other person as a friend that he wanted to be close to, rather than a superior master.
People rarely stab their friends, but too many masters have died at the hands of their slaves.
Liu Chang got the tools he needed as he wished, including a ruler, plane, and file. Although he didn't have an axe, he could already start making them.
However, after leaving here, Liu Chang was not so happy, but his mood was a little heavy.
"Brother...is my father a benevolent and righteous emperor?"
"Yes."
"Then why did he treat those people like this? They were naked...why didn't they get a carriage?"
"Do you know how many craftsmen there were who built Changle Palace?"
"I don't know."
"Tens of thousands of people."
"My father did not starve them and gave them time to rest. They only had to work hard for a few months after the busy farming season. This is already a great gift."
"Is this considered a gift?"
"Of course. Do you know how many people built the Great Wall?"
"There should be a lot..."
"Most of them have to prepare their own food and don't have much time to rest... During the reign of Qin II, construction was going on all year round. They couldn't go home when they were busy farming. The farmland was abandoned. When the food was used up, they could only get a little bit of food every day, shoddy. They wore shackles and lived in the wild. The soldiers would kill the people who couldn't do the work at any time... Think about it now, is my father a benevolent and righteous emperor?"
"Yes."
This time, Liu Chang finally did not hesitate. If compared to the past, Liu Bang was indeed one of the rare benevolent emperors. To build the palace for himself, he only mobilized tens of thousands of people to work and provide food and drink. It was quite on time. He would rather miss work than delay the farm work, and would not kill people indiscriminately.
"But...I still think they are having a bad life."
"They are not the only ones who are having a bad time."
Liu Heng did not discuss this issue with Liu Chang anymore and said goodbye to him calmly. But before leaving, Liu Heng stared into his eyes and said seriously: "When you become the king of princes in the future, don't forget what you saw today."
Liu Chang froze on the spot, watching Liu Heng move away.
He suddenly felt that maybe this brother was more suitable to be emperor than Liu Ying, but it was a pity that the fourth brother was not the eldest son.
Back to Jiaofang Palace, everything is thereLiu Chang, the tool manager, started to make the spinning wheel. Since the design drawings had been made before, it was much easier to make these parts. He first wanted to make the heald frame and frame.
He found the timber he had hidden. Most of these timbers were square and could be used as they came without Chang Liu having to perform any other processing. Since there were no nails, he could only use mortise and tenon joints to stabilize the frame.
Mortise and tenon joints are easy to say, but for those who don't know carpentry, it is really difficult to make them. Liu Chang had never made mortise and tenon joints in his previous life. The previous assembly failed due to measurement and wood problems, and it fell apart. Because there were no advanced machines, Liu Chang had to do everything by himself. Just making the mortise and tenon joints took Liu Chang a long time.
He worked harder than before, probably because he had seen what the craftsmen wore, and the rag strips were vivid in his mind.
Just as Liu Chang made the frame and started assembling the internal parts, Liu Bang prepared the apprenticeship ceremony.
In this era, the apprenticeship ceremony was called Shuxiu, which usually consisted of ten strips of dried meat. In order to show respect, Liu Bang specially prepared some other things. When sending someone to send Liu Chang over, Liu Bang was still telling Liu Chang: This is for your teacher! You bastard, don’t eat it secretly! !
Liu Chang was very dissatisfied. Who am I?
Liu Chang finally left the palace. This was his first time out of the palace. He also became the fourth prince to leave the palace besides Liu Fei, Liu Ying and Liu Ruyi. Sitting on the carriage, Liu Chang was curious about everything. Unfortunately, the situation outside the palace was no different from that inside the palace.
Everywhere was desolate, no one could be seen, the gray buildings isolated everything, and Han Xin's mansion was too close to the palace. Liu Chang had already arrived at Han Xin's mansion before he saw anyone. Han Xin had already learned the news and sent his servants to greet the prince.
The apprenticeship ceremony was not as complicated as Liu Chang thought.
It's just a simple matter of kneeling down and bowing, offering the bundle to repair, the teacher nodding, and that's it.
Liu Chang was very curious about his teacher. In the past, he admired Han Xin more, but after Empress Lu's words, he was a little afraid of Han Xin. He did not know much about the future, but even so, he also knew about Liu Bang's killing of heroes.
Han Xin seems to have been executed by Liu Bang.
Liu Chang didn't know what Han Xin had done, but he knew that his father was not a person who liked to kill people randomly. Liu Chang had already learned a lot about Han Xin from other people's mouths. Han Xin was indeed very famous in the Han Dynasty, and his brothers all knew him well.
However, they half admired and half disdained Han Xin.
Liu Ruyi once told Liu Chang face to face that Han Xin was just a failed rebel.
From Liu Ruyi's words, Liu Chang just learned that Han Xin turned out to be the King of Chu. This was incredible to Liu Chang, who was blind to history. Isn't the King of Chu Xiang Yu? ? Han Xin did not serve as King of Chu for too long. After he became King of Chu, he began to train horses and soldiers, hoard food, and make friends...
Liu Bang couldn't sit still. Han Xin had a criminal record.
When Liu Bang fought with Xiang Yu and was beaten by Xiang Yu, Han Xin was on the ground and won one after another. So Liu Bang asked Han Xin for help and ordered him to come to the rescue quickly, and Han Xin sent an envoy.
Han Xin's envoy told Liu Bang that it was okay to let Han Xin come to the rescue, but you must make Han Xin the false king.
Liu Bang was furious and cursed in front of Han Xin's envoy: "Han Xin is such an idiot. I'm trapped here. If he doesn't save me, what does he want to do to be a false king?"
When Chen Ping heard this, he immediately kicked Liu Bang hard with his toes.
Liu Bang hurriedly changed his words and cursed: "Han Xin is so unambitious! If a man can conquer the princes, then he has to be a true king. Why do he have to do anything?"What a fake king! ! "
This incident made Liu Bang always worried. Later, when Liu Bang ascended the throne and named Han Xin the King of Chu, he soon realized that Han Xin had evil thoughts. Therefore, Liu Bang asked Chen Ping for advice and asked whether he should send troops to attack Han Xin.
Liu Chang felt that at that time Chen Ping must have wanted to scold: Crusade Han Xin? Does your Majesty have some calculations in mind? ?
However, Chen Ping still did not curse, he just asked calmly: "Is your army more powerful than Han Xin's? "
"Who among your generals can defeat Han Xin? "
Then Liu Bang shut up and started asking for a safe way.
Chen Ping gave him Yunmengze's plan and asked Liu Bang to pretend to be Yunmengze and meet with various princes in Chenzhou. Chenzhou was on the western border of Chu. Han Xin heard that the emperor was traveling and came to his territory again, so he came to pay an audience. When he paid an audience to Liu Bang, Liu Bang directly sent people to kidnap him and took him back.
In this way, without any effort, Liu Bang captured Han Xin, dismissed him as King of Chu on charges of treason, and changed his title to Marquis of Huaiyin.
Even so, Liu Bang did not kill him, causing future troubles forever. Speaking of which, Liu Bang was really not a murderous person. Based on Han Xin's behavior, any other king would probably kill him.
Therefore, Liu Chang felt that Han Xin would be executed by Liu Bang because he must have done something big later that caused Liu Bang to kill him.
